data.body: Note: in this very session, merge-to-main.sh produced a DESCRIPTIVE PR title for PR #136 ('fix(sprint): add HARD GATE prohibiting plan-review substitution in Phase B Step 2b (dea8-3ca9)') — i.e., the most recent commit's subject. The 'Merge remote-tracking branch origin/main into worktree-...' anti-pattern the user reported did NOT reproduce here, which suggests the bad title is triggered by a specific condition (likely: branch where the latest commit IS a merge-back from origin/main, so the auto-derived title falls through to the merge-commit subject instead of a feature-commit subject). Investigation should reproduce by creating a branch whose HEAD is a merge from main, then running merge-to-main.sh, and confirming the resulting PR title.
